BiblicalUsage: Jezoar is named once, in 1 Chronicles 4:7. In 1 Chronicles 4:7 we read, "And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan."
TheologicalSignificance: Jezoar is part of the family history Scripture preserves, and I believe those lists are not filler.
